name: AppImage recipes
tagline: Recipes and build specifications to generate AppImages with AppImageKit
description: A collection of build recipes and Continuous Integration templates maintained by TheAssassin and the AppImage community. Provides automated pkg2appimage recipes to package upstream Debian/Ubuntu binaries, compile native libraries, and package compliant AppImages.
features: Ready-to-use YAML and Bash recipes for dozens of popular open source apps
GitHub Actions and Travis CI continuous delivery workflow examples
Helper scripts to strip unnecessary libraries and bundle shared runtimes
AppStream metainfo validation and AppImage desktop integration testing
